description: An allow_always for an action type covers all its tools.

input.scenario: Tools log_sets and add_set both map to dev.example.sets.log. The person answers allow_always to a log_sets proposal in session s1; the agent then calls add_set in s1.

expect.behaviour: The add_set proposal is accepted by the stored grant (answer.by grant) with a decision record; a proposal of another action type is still asked.
